criteria.requirement: Implement sqlglot.report_inspection.query_copy, physical_nodes and inspect_tables(query,*,dialect=None) returning frozen TableReference(catalog,database,name,alias,quoted,scope) occurrences. Parse exactly one Query or copy supplied Query; reject empty/multiple/nonquery input. Use actual traverse_scope to exclude CTE references (including shadowing), retain physical tables inside CTE bodies, nested subqueries, self joins and SEMI/ANTI RHS. Preserve exact identifier case and catalog/db/name quote flags, scope traversal order and input AST/parent links. Ignore table functions/dynamic names rather than labeling them physical tables. Do not use regex table extraction or schema guesses.
